correctness.rationale: For the exactly defined twelve-edge cube matching complex, the verifier recomputes 107 oriented faces, exact boundary ranks (11,31,9), a determinant -1 maximal D2 minor and a +1 determinant 9-by-9 D3 minor in the integral kernel. These exhibit torsion-free H2=Z4, with zero other reduced integral homology. It explicitly constructs the quotient map and an integral homology basis, computes all 48 induced matrices, compares their traces to independent signed Lefschetz sums and checks the complete character formula. Central inversion has integral matrix J of order two; exact eigenlattice generators have determinant absolute value 2. All claims are finite and quantifiers are exhausted.

value.rationale: The canonical cube matching complex was previously known nonequivariantly to have four integral two-dimensional homology generators. The new complete S4-by-C2 symmetry character identifies a sign-twisted irreducible 3-dimensional standard part and an antipodal-odd fixed line; more importantly the integral eigensublattices have index two, exposing a natural 2-primary extension not recoverable from any Betti number or rational semisimple module. This exact obstruction is a nontrivial, motivated structural invariant of matching homology on the smallest three-direction hypercube. It provides a concrete integral-equivariance benchmark while making no higher-cube theorem claim.
